definition: a person who needs medical care
description: A free health check under a white gazebo at a school fair. A young woman in a white nurse's tunic leans over a seated young man and shines a small lit instrument into his ear. He tips his head back, opens his mouth wide and she presses his tongue down with a wooden stick and looks into his throat. She then straps a blue blood pressure cuff around his upper arm and listens while he sits still and smiles. Other students queue behind the table, watching and giving a thumbs up.
transcript: Look up, say uh-uh. - Uh. - All good?
